label: A0
information: No-error reference; zero applied physical error.

label: C0
information: Production Current with +4 ns unknown channel delay and no correction.

label: PK
information: Known physical correction; true delay is evaluator-only and not estimator input.

label: Fixed_D3
information: Static R9-frozen D3 correction; same fixed value across cases, no case truth used.

label: Huber_D3_ON
information: Robust D3 delay fit from same-case target-present A1/Current raw C1-C2 observations.
comparability: Deployable-information condition in this simulator; estimator is deterministic.

label: M1_Physics_Matched
information: Physics-matched delay plus constant-complex-gain fit from same-case target-present A1/Current raw C1-C2 observations.
comparability: Deployable-information condition in this simulator; estimator is deterministic.

label: P1_OFF_estimate
information: Blind physical delay estimate from paired target-free OFF input; applies correction to ON.
comparability: Diagnostic-only information; does not establish target-present online estimation.

label: P2_Mode-A
information: Paired target-free OFF physical-delay estimate; robust DDC-RB Mode-A reference policy.
comparability: Compare only with C4 Mode-A and PKR Mode-A; not directly with PK.

label: P2_Mode-B
information: Paired target-free OFF physical-delay estimate; robust DDC-RB Mode-B uses ON reference observations.
comparability: Compare only with C4 Mode-B and PKR Mode-B; incomplete triplet coverage.

label: C4_Mode-A
information: Robust DDC-RB Mode-A, paired OFF reference policy.

label: C4_Mode-B
information: Robust DDC-RB Mode-B, ON reference policy; frozen min_support=8, phase gate=0.35 rad.
comparability: P2 Mode-B current reference; report coverage separately.

label: PKR_Mode-A
information: Known physical correction then Robust DDC-RB Mode-A.
comparability: P2 Mode-A known reference; evaluator-only delay.

label: PKR_Mode-B
information: Known physical correction then Robust DDC-RB Mode-B.
comparability: P2 Mode-B known reference; evaluator-only delay and method gaps.
